verdict.rationale: Smooth is a hosted browser-agent service, so letting developers bring their own LLM provider is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no way to do this: the docs say Smooth runs its own 'small and efficient AI models', with no option to plug in another provider. The CLI working with any calling agent (Claude Code, OpenClaw, others) is a different capability about which agent drives Smooth, not about choosing the model behind Smooth.
